edits.before: - Zoe Sleepy Trouble Bubble: matchup-defining — Sleep into empowered Q is the entire kill pattern — body-block it with minions or terrain. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your E Aegis Assault like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Zoe Sleepy Trouble Bubble (E): 18s at rank 1 — sleep into charged Q is her whole kill pattern; body-block it with minions or terrain and commit in the downtime. - Her Q runs 8.5s. - Guard your E Aegis Assault (22s) like a fifth summoner spell; ultimate goes to kill windows only.

Late, Zoe fishes for picks from fog: a 14-second Sleepy Trouble Bubble into a max-range Paddle Star one-shots carries, and her Portal Jump forces her back to its start point after one second — punish the return. Flank her in fights; she has no answer to a W-stun that arrives before her bubble does.
